name: Strip View Condo
address_area: Paradise, NV, 10 minutes' walk from the south Strip (full address sent with the access details)

checkin.how: Self check-in with a keypad on the unit door. Take elevator B to floor 12.

checkout.how: Start the dishwasher, put used towels in the bathtub, close the door; it locks itself.

parking: One free self-parking spot in garage level P2, any unmarked space. Valet at the resort costs extra.
amenities: Resort pool 9 AM-8 PM, wristband at front desk
local_tips: Coffee: the cafe in the lobby opens 6 AM
Groceries: Smith's on Tropicana, 5 minutes by car
Strip shows: the concierge desk can book same-day tickets
